source: SIMBAD (CDS), queried through the CfA mirror TAP service

queries.T: (b.sp_type LIKE 'T%' OR b.sp_type LIKE 'Y%') AND f.J > 11.0 AND f.J < 17.2
queries.L: b.sp_type LIKE 'L%' AND f.J > 11.0 AND f.J < 16.5
queries.M_late: (b.sp_type LIKE 'M6%' OR b.sp_type LIKE 'M7%' OR b.sp_type LIKE 'M8%' OR b.sp_type LIKE 'M9%') AND f.J BETWEEN 11.0 AND 15.5 AND (b.pmra*b.pmra + b.pmdec*b.pmdec) > 10000
queries.M_mid: (b.sp_type LIKE 'M3%' OR b.sp_type LIKE 'M4%' OR b.sp_type LIKE 'M5%') AND f.J BETWEEN 12 AND 14.5 AND (b.pmra*b.pmra + b.pmdec*b.pmdec) > 40000
queries.U_bd: b.otype = 'BD?' AND (b.sp_type IS NULL OR b.sp_type = '') AND f.J > 11.0 AND f.J < 17.2
queries.U_pm: b.otype = 'PM*' AND (b.sp_type IS NULL OR b.sp_type = '') AND f.J BETWEEN 13 AND 17.2 AND f.J - f.K > 1.0 AND (b.pmra*b.pmra + b.pmdec*b.pmdec) > 40000
